source.name: KNVBshop.nl (official KNVB shop) – 'Nike Dutch Team Home Shirt 2026-2028'
source.note: Kit maker. Official KNVB fan shop selling the shirt players wear at the 2026 World Cup. Nike officially unveiled the 2026 home kit in March 2026 (Footy Headlines, 2026-04-01: https://www.footyheadlines.com/2025/02/netherlands-2026-home-kit.html).
source.quote: Discover the new Nike Dutch Team Home Shirt 2026-2028, which is derived from the shirt that players wear during matches, such as the 2026 World Cup!

summary: No commercial sponsor on the shirt: like other national teams, the Netherlands' match kit carries only the Nike mark and the KNVB crest. Nike makes the 2026 World Cup kit.
